message.content: List all files including . prefixed files and folders in ~ (home directory). Run: ls -la ~ and also ls -la ~/.openclaw if it exists. Show the complete output.

input.command: ls -la ~ && echo "---" && ls -la ~/.openclaw 2>/dev/null || echo "~/.openclaw does not exist"
